issues.title: Ingest Ouachita County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $16,099,196 across 28 funds. The largest: Jail Operating ($5,753,114), County General ($4,015,711), County Road ($3,380,935). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Get the adopted 2026 appropriation ordinance
issues.detail: The filing is the 2026 proposed budget (“Request 2026”); it doesn’t show the quorum court’s final vote. Ask the county clerk for the ordinance the quorum court adopted, and check these amounts against it.
